transcript: Speaker A: Which pasta would you like? White sauce, red sauce, or pink sauce? Speaker B: I'll take the red sauce. Speaker C: I'll have the pink sauce. It looks delicious. Speaker D: Hmm, mujhe koi bhi de do, mujhe samajh nahi aa raha. [Hmm, give me any, I don't understand.] Speaker A: Kya hua Apple? Tum ro kyun rahi ho? [What happened Apple? Why are you crying?] Speaker D: Aaj kitty party mein sab mujhpe hase, kyunki mujhe English bolni nahi aati. [Today at the kitty party everyone laughed at me, because I don't know how to speak English.] Speaker A: Bas itni si baat? Ye lo, tum English Seekho app use karna shuru karo. Dekho isme AI coach hai, 24 ghante available hai. Tum isse roz 10 minute baat karo, ye tumhe English bolna sikha degi. Galti bhi ho to sharmao mat, judge nahi karegi. 500 baar galat bolo, 500 baar sudharegi. Ye tumhe daily life mein English mein kaise baat karna hai sikha degi. General English show mein 'Hello se baat shuru karein' se start karo. 1 lakh se zyada log seekh chuke hain. Good manners ke English words dekho: Please, Thank you, Excuse me. Kitty party mein yahi chahiye. Roz ke 10 easy sentences se daily practice karo. Ek mahine mein farq dikhega. Phir dekhte hain kiski himmat hai jo tumhara mazaak udaye. [Just this? Here, start using the English Seekho app. Look, it has an AI coach, available 24 hours. Talk to it for 10 minutes daily, it will teach you to speak English. Even if you make a mistake, don't be shy, it won't judge. Speak wrong 500 times, it will correct you 500 times. It will teach you how to talk in English in daily life. Start with 'Start conversation with Hello' in the General English show. More than 1 lakh people have learned. Look at English words for good manners: Please, Thank you, Excuse me. This is what is needed in a kitty party. Practice daily with 10 easy sentences. You will see a difference in a month. Then let's see who dares to make fun of you.] Speaker E: To install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
